evals.prompt: Convert docs/q3-review.md to an HTML file I can email to the Northwind Health ops committee. Use ./brand/brand.json and add a contents box. It has a results table, a screenshot at img/dashboard.png and one Mermaid flowchart. Some people on the committee read email offline on the train.
assertions: Runs md_to_html.py with --brand ./brand/brand.json and --toc, writing a single .html file
Does not use --mermaid cdn without saying the file then needs network; because readers are offline, offers to render the flowchart to SVG with mermaid-render or keeps it as text
Reports the image as embedded, or names it as missing if the script warned it was not found
Relays every warning the script printed in plain words, not just the counts
Does not invent content, numbers or sections that are not in docs/q3-review.md
Tells the user to print-preview the file and check an anchor link
